metadata.title: Senoia Porchfest 2023
metadata.description: A recap of the 2nd annual Senoia Porch Festival. Thank you to all the artists, booths, and vendors for helping put together an amazing experience! Shout out to Enjoy Senoia for putting together an awesome festival and giving me the chance to capture it. Until next year!
